failure_summary.description: Agents consistently select longer, expanded, or alternative phrasings (e.g., full names, compound alternatives, or related distractors) instead of the exact canonical short answer expected by the gold standard.

patch.reasoning: All three failures stem from the agent extracting semantically valid but non-canonical strings from the context (expanding acronyms, including alternatives like 'or', or picking related distractors). Adding explicit directives for acronym priority and alternative/distractor exclusion will force the agent to isolate the precise, minimal canonical term.

edits.target: - **Avoid converting declarative clues into Yes/No answers.**
edits.content:
- **Acronym & Abbreviation Priority**: When the context provides both a full name and its acronym/abbreviation (e.g., "Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA)"), default to the acronym/abbreviation unless the clue explicitly requests the full name.
- **Alternative & Compound Exclusion**: Strictly avoid outputting combined alternatives (e.g., "Sheep or goat"), broader categories, or semantically related distractors. Isolate the single most specific, canonical term that directly satisfies the clue.
